title: Quantization and Biphoton Statistics of k-Gap Solitons in Nonlinear Photonic Time Crystals
summary: Nonlinear photonic time crystals (PTCs) can support solitons inside momentum k gaps, where the amplification of k gap modes is saturated by Kerr nonlinearity, forming spatially homogeneous but temporally localized excitations. Yet their quantum nature remains unclear. Here we quantize nonlinear k gap dynamics of PTCs and show that k gap solitons are represented by biphoton Fock ladder states.
